import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier
from lightgbm import lgb_eval
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Read data from correct locations
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Extract target column
y_train = train["Cover_Type"]
feature_columns = [col for col in train.columns if col != "Id" and col != "Cover_Type"]
X_train_full = train[feature_columns]
X_test = test[feature_columns].copy()
X_test.columns = feature_columns

# Calculate class weights for imbalanced data
class_counts = y_train.value_counts()
total_samples = len(y_train)
scale_pos_weight = (total_samples - class_counts.iloc[0]) / class_counts.iloc[0]
print(f"Scale pos weight: {scale_pos_weight:.4f}")

# Split training data into train and validation (genuine holdout)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, random_state=42, test_size=0.2, shuffle=True
)

print(f"Training rows: {len(X_tr)}, Validation rows: {len(X_val)}")

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_tr_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test)

# Train LightGBM classifier with optimized defaults and early stopping
model = LGBMClassifier(
    random_state=42,
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=10,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    min_child_samples=20,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1.0,
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    verbosity=-1,
    n_jobs=-1,
)

callbacks = [lgb_eval(lambda dtrain, evals_result: print("Training completed"))]
model.fit(
    X_tr_scaled,
    y_tr,
    validate_sets=[(X_val_scaled, y_val)],
    early_stopping_rounds=50,
    verbose=False,
    callbacks=callbacks,
)

# Predictions on validation set for evaluation
val_preds = model.predict(X_val_scaled)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation Accuracy (hold-out): {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Get final predictions on test set ONLY
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_scaled)

# Create submission file properly formatted
submission = sample_submission.copy()
submission["Cover_Type"] = test_preds.astype(int)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv with", len(submission), "rows")
print(f"Final prediction count: {len(test_preds)}")
print(f"Multi-class Classification Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")
print("Model trained and submission created successfully!")
